name: Spectrum River
pitch: A luminous river of model activity becomes the canvas, the timeline, and the interface.
tradeoff: The immersive overview gives up precise daily comparison and persistent tool names.
fontWhy: Soft display curves echo the river; quiet UI lettering and tabular monospaced data keep it readable.
logoIdea: One unbroken run branches into three balanced traces on a geometric river-delta grid.
sliderIdea: Two draggable light beams bracket the daily stream, dimming and desaturating everything outside the window.
signatureMotion: Fine travelling highlights flow along every band; a hovered model swells while the others recede.
